title: Zap! Snowboarding Trix
native_title: ザップ！ スノーボーディング・トリックス
overview: Zap! Snowboarding Trix is a snowboarding game endorsed by pro snowboarder Masao "Bubbles" Misawa. The game includes three single-player modes: Race Mode is an arcade-style race against a computer opponent; Practice Mode is a single-player time trial that records best times; and Free Mode is has no goals and removes the time limit. There are three courses, three boarders with different stats, and five computer difficulty levels.
